thread:
alice.sec: Urgent security advisory: we discovered rotated-but-still-valid GCP service account JSON keys lingering in multiple CI vaults. Immediate action required: remove all long-lived JSON keys and switch to OIDC or short-lived tokens by 2026-06-10. This is high priority for compliance.

alice.sec: Scope: keys found in 18 repos and 6 vault paths. We will auto-fail CI for workflows that reference `activate-service-account --key-file` after the deadline.

alice.sec: Quick remediation steps:
- Identify: `git grep -n "activate-service-account --key-file" || git grep -n "service-account.json"`
- Rotate: create a new short-lived token via token-broker or bind workload identity for GitHub Actions.
- Remove secrets from Vault and rotate any corresponding IAM grants.

deploy-bot: scan-report: scanned 512 repos 93 flagged items. CSV uploaded to #security-scans. Owners will be DM[0m.

bob.dev: Is there a grace period if removing key breaks a deployment?

alice.sec: Short window for emergency exceptions: open an exception ticket with `exp:sa-json` tag and include rollback plan and owner. Exceptions expire in 7 days; we expect teams to remediate immediately.

carol.sre: We'll run an automated job to attempt replacing JSON keys with OIDC for SRE-owned repos. Will report failures.

dave.eng: Can we get a helper script to scrub base64 blobs and open PRs removing keys? I can contribute.

alice.sec: Please coordinate with @platform-team. Add `security:inflight` label to PRs so scans ignore them.

eve.vpsec: Thanks team. This reduces credential leak risk. Escalate any blockers to me by EOD tomorrow.

alice.sec: Final note: enforcement will block legacy `--key-file` usage in CI lints and IAM proxy starting 2026-06-11. Reach out in-thread for repo-specific help. :lock:
